mapper.select: select from ${mtgSyncTable} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ${mtgSyncTable} (biz, type, cfgid, enabled, dir_oa2third, dir_third2oa, app_id, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.biz}, #{e.type}, #{e.cfgid}, #{e.enabled}, #{e.dirOa2Third}, #{e.dirThird2Oa}, #{e.appId}, #{e.remark}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
mapper.select: select b.id, b.cfg_id, b.app_name, b.agent_id, b.app_secret, b.yx, c.corp_id as cfg_corp_id, c.corp_secret as cfg_corp_secret from ${appBindTable} b left join ${cfgTable} c on c.id = b.cfg_id where b.id = #{appId} and c.type = #{type}
mapper.insert: insert into ${mtgSyncLogTable} (biz, type, cfgid, batch_id, oa_id, oa_title, oa_sub_id, oa_sub_name, oa_dept_id, oa_dept_name, begin_time, end_time, wx_id, op, message, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.biz}, #{e.type}, #{e.cfgid}, #{e.batchId}, #{e.oaId}, #{e.oaTitle}, #{e.oaSubId}, #{e.oaSubName}, #{e.oaDeptId}, #{e.oaDeptName}, #{e.beginTime}, #{e.endTime}, #{e.wxId}, #{e.op}, #{e.message}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
mapper.select:
select top ${limit} , c.corp_name as cfg_name from ${mtgSyncLogTable} l left join ${cfgTable} c on c.id = l.cfgid
order by l.modedatacreatedate desc, l.modedatacreatetime desc, l.id desc
select count(1) from ${mtgSyncLogTable} l

select top 1 l.wx_id from ${mtgSyncLogTable} l where l.biz = #{biz} and l.type = #{type} and l.cfgid = #{cfgId} and l.oa_id = #{oaId} and l.op in (0, 1) and l.wx_id is not null and l.wx_id <> '' order by l.id desc
mapper.sql: cast(m.id as varchar(64)) as oa_id, m.name as title, m.desc_n as content, case when len(isnull(nullif(m.beginDateTime, ''), '')) >= 16 then m.beginDateTime when isnull(m.begindate, '') <> '' then isnull(m.begindate, '') + ' ' + isnull(m.begintime, '') else isnull(nullif(m.beginDateTime, ''), '') end as begin_time, case when len(isnull(nullif(m.endDateTime, ''), '')) >= 16 then m.endDateTime when isnull(m.enddate, '') <> '' then isnull(m.enddate, '') + ' ' + isnull(m.endtime, '') else isnull(nullif(m.endDateTime, ''), '') end as end_time, case when m.hrmSubCompanys is null or m.hrmSubCompanys = '' then (select cast(h.subcompanyid1 as varchar(32)) from hrmresource h where h.id = m.creater) else m.hrmSubCompanys end as raw_sub_ids, m.hrmDepartments as dept_id, cast(m.creater as varchar(32)) as owner_id, m.address as location, case when m.cancel = '1' then 1 else 0 end as deleted
mapper.select: select top ${limit} from ${mtgMeetingTable} m where (m.cancel is null or m.cancel <> '1') and ((m.createdate >= #{fromDate} and m.createdate <= #{toDate}) or (m.begindate >= #{fromDate} and m.begindate <= #{toDate})) order by m.begindate, m.begintime, m.id
select cast(mm.memberid as varchar(32)) from ${mtgMeetingMemberTable} mm where mm.meetingid = #{oaId} and mm.membertype = 0
mapper.sql: cast(w.id as varchar(64)) as oa_id, w.name as title, w.description as content, isnull(w.begindate, '') + ' ' + isnull(w.begintime, '') as begin_time, isnull(w.enddate, '') + ' ' + isnull(w.endtime, '') as end_time, cast(w.subcompanyId as varchar(32)) as sub_id, cast(w.deptId as varchar(32)) as dept_id, cast(w.createrid as varchar(32)) as owner_id, w.location as location, case when w.deleted = '1' then 1 else 0 end as deleted
mapper.select: select top ${limit} from ${mtgScheduleTable} w where (w.deleted is null or w.deleted <> '1') and w.subcompanyId is not null and ((w.createdate >= #{fromDate} and w.createdate <= #{toDate}) or (w.begindate >= #{fromDate} and w.begindate <= #{toDate})) order by w.begindate, w.begintime, w.id
select distinct cast(wm.resourceid as varchar(32)) from ${mtgScheduleMemberTable} wm where wm.workplanid = #{oaId} and wm.resourceid is not null
select distinct b.x_user_id from ${userBindTable} b where b.cfg_id = #{cfgId} and b.bind_state = 1 and b.x_user_id is not null and b.x_user_id <> '' and b.oa_user_id in #{uid}

mapper.select: select oa_id from ${mtgLinkTable} where biz = #{biz} and type = #{type} and cfgid = #{cfgId} and source = 1
mapper.insert: insert into ${mtgLinkTable} (biz, type, cfgid, oa_id, wx_id, source, oa_hash, wx_hash, last_pull_time, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.biz}, #{e.type}, #{e.cfgid}, #{e.oaId}, #{e.wxId}, #{e.source}, #{e.oaHash}, #{e.wxHash}, #{e.lastPullTime}, #{e.remark}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
